name: Piney
summary: Forest Service lookout in Phelps County: 1937-41 CCC-era records, a survey note that it blew down, and a 2023 article describing a tower on the trail. Status disputed.
status_note: One lookout site lists it as removed. A January 2023 article describes a fire tower on the trail, surrounded by barbed wire, and says climbing is not allowed.

access.note: Hiking trail to the tower; per a 2023 article, the tower is surrounded by barbed wire and climbing is not allowed.

visit.trail_note: About 4.2 miles in total on the hiking trail, per All Trails as cited in a 2023 article.

events.note: Temporary lookout planned: an open crow's nest atop a 40-foot pine pole, per a News and Tribune report quoted on the Central US Lookouts page
CCC company newspaper item names Kenneth Jackson as in charge, with Joe Turner and Pershing Snodgrass; the quoted item does not name the tower
Cabin being built at the Piney Lookout Tower for CCC lookouts to use on duty, per the Rolla Herald quoted on the Central US Lookouts page
Coast and Geodetic Survey station description; calls it the Piney Lookout Tower (Forest Service)
Travel article describes a fire tower looming over the trail, surrounded by barbed wire, and not stable for climbers
